title: Adding a file data type to Iceberg v4
summary: After the Parquet FILE logical type merged (parquet-format#585), Nitya Kumar Sharma shared a proposal document for a matching `file` data type in Iceberg, limited to type-level semantics and leaving credential vending and brokered access to the catalog. He said it was not a counter-proposal to the existing document by Talat Uyarer, Alex Stephen and Sung Yun, which covers both the type and catalog-brokered credential vending. Points for discussion included representing file as a named struct with six fixed leaves, allowing only inline and external forms, resolving relative URIs against the table location, ordinary per-leaf statistics, and no use as a partition, sort or equality-delete key. Russell Spitzer hoped the proposals would converge, and Daniel Weeks asked to consolidate around updating the existing proposal instead of starting a new effort. Nitya agreed to consolidate there and later asked the original authors how best to collaborate; the thread has no further reply.

positions.stance: Converge on the file type's semantics separately from access control, with file as a named struct of six fixed leaves and only inline and external forms.
Wants consensus between this proposal and the existing one from Talat and co-authors.
The community should consolidate around updating the existing proposal instead of starting a new effort.

outcome.note: The author agreed to fold the work into the existing file type proposal; his later request to its authors about how to collaborate received no reply in the thread.

why_it_matters: File type design work was steered into a single proposal instead of two competing documents.
